newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 4.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi plans to introduce advanced irrigation system to reduce water consumption, agriculture and water minister says.
- National Shipping Company of Saudi Arabia to build three container ships, each with a capacity to carry 4,000 containers.
- Around 23 Saudi firms will take part in Cairo internationl exhibition in March.
- Saudi Consolidated Electric Company - East to distribute 54 million riyals to shareholders.
